content.text: In regions where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-what-actually-how-11|COREMERCH guide to payment]]-solutions-zimbabwean-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-payment-solutions-west-africa-what-nobody|Digital Product]]-sellers-honest-side-side|payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or heavily restricted, deploying a digital store can feel impossible. Countries relying on these platforms often face significant barriers, leaving digital creators without a viable way to sell their products. COREMERCH provides an infrastructure solution designed to empower those creators, allowing them to set up an online store that processes crypto payments seamlessly. This guide will walk you through deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, ensuring you can transact and deliver digital products without reliance on traditional payment systems.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Stack 02 leverages the robust architecture of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments to create a sovereign commerce environment. Unlike conventional platforms that impose restrictions, this stack offers full data ownership and complete control over your online store. With crypto payment processing, you eliminate the need for intermediaries, ensuring that you can receive payments regardless of regional banking limitations. This system is designed to be resilient, allowing you to operate your business freely without the threat of account bans or service denials that plague other payment processors.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you begin the deployment process, gather all necessary resources. You should have a Cloudflare account set up, ready to host your site on Cloudflare Pages. Additionally, prepare your digital products, whether they are ebooks, courses, or templates, ensuring they are ready for upload. A NOWPayments account is essential for processing your crypto transactions, and you will also need to create a Google account to utilize Google Apps Script for backend logic. By gathering these resources in advance, you streamline your deployment process and ensure a smoother setup.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Initiate the deployment by setting up your backend logic using Google Apps Script. This will handle payment confirmation and product delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for your payment processing, ensuring you configure it to accept various cryptocurrencies. After setting up the backend, create a Cloudflare Pages project where you will host your site. Upload your product files to a designated storage solution like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Ensure that your payment confirmation process triggers immediate access to the product for buyers upon successful transaction. This step is crucial for maintaining customer satisfaction and trust.
Deploy your digital store without relying on traditional payment platforms.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, it’s time to go live. Test your deployment thoroughly by processing a test transaction using your configured payment gateway. Verify that the payment confirmation triggers the correct delivery mechanism for your digital product. Monitor the transaction flow, ensuring that customers receive their products immediately after payment confirmation. This is your opportunity to confirm that your infrastructure is functioning as intended. After successful testing, promote your store across relevant channels to attract customers and start generating sales.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store live, focus on scaling your operations. You can add more products to your store, leveraging the Complete Builder Kit to access additional blueprints and templates. Consider optimizing your backend for performance, utilizing Cloudflare’s features to enhance site speed and reliability. Engage with your audience through email campaigns or social media to drive traffic to your store. As your sales grow, continuously assess your infrastructure needs and scale accordingly, ensuring that you maintain a seamless experience for your customers.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, start by choosing a robust infrastructure like Cloudflare Pages combined with NOWPayments. This setup allows you to host your store and process transactions without traditional payment systems. By following deployment guidelines, you can create a fully functional digital storefront in a matter of hours.
Enjoy full ownership and control of your online commerce infrastructure.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build your digital store by using Cloudflare Pages and integrating NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This setup eliminates reliance on traditional payment platforms and offers full control over your store.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Apps Script for a simple deployment, while Stack 02 employs Cloudflare Pages and Workers for a more robust and scalable infrastructure. Stack 02 is also end-to-end tested before handoff.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent options for hosting your digital product store. They provide reliable hosting and can be integrated with backend solutions for payment processing.
How long does it take to deploy Stack 01 and Stack 02?
Deploying Stack 01 typically takes 4-6 hours when following the Sovereign Blueprint, while Stack 02 is completed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with comprehensive testing.
What types of products can I sell using this infrastructure?
You can sell a variety of digital products, including ebooks, courses, software, templates, and more. The infrastructure supports seamless product delivery and crypto payment processing.
